pos.personaBrief: Opta: far more 10+ pass sequences than any team; Zagallo built a team 'to defend with the ball', Bleacher: 'craved possession', yet the Italy goal was patient build-up then speed.

pro.personaBrief: Build-up from Piazza, Clodoaldo, Gerson with patient circulation to exhaust man-markers, then vertical speed; short play out from the back.

est.personaBrief: Five attackers constantly interchanged, Rivellino drifted inside, Tostao roamed to the flanks and dropped; fluid roles rather than fixed zones, though with defined defensive duties.

lar.personaBrief: Attack mixed: Carlos Alberto crossing and flank switches, Jairzinho on the right, but Rivellino and the five 10s drifted centrally and wingers were not fixed wide.

blo.personaBrief: Zagallo's own account: marking from midfield, not pressing the build-up; low 4-4-1-1 block against structured attacks, compressing the pitch, relying on heat limiting pressing.

mar.personaBrief: Brazil's own scheme is not stated; midfield block with covering back line suggests spatial zonal defending rather than dedicated man-marking, while opponents man-marked.

pla.personaBrief: Zagallo imposed his 4-3-3 over Saldanha's 4-2-4 and kept it, but prepared Italy-specific movements and kept the same eleven; own identity dominant.

res.personaBrief: Expressive, attacking team with five 10s; won the final 4-1 and kept attacking, not shutting down.

sis.personaBrief: Stars with freedom to interchange, yet Zagallo demanded everyone return to mark and defined roles (Pelé helping midfield, Tostao sacrifice); talent-led within a collective.

jog.personaBrief: Hugely technical side with five 10s and a classic playmaker in Gerson, backed by a pioneering scientific physical programme and altitude acclimatisation.

bas.personaBrief: Experienced, established stars (Pelé, Gerson, Carlos Alberto) picked for a title; Zagallo cut youngsters like Dirceu Lopes; no academy focus.

lid.personaBrief: Zagallo demanded discipline, order and self-sacrifice from all, but also managed the stars' morale, kept a good atmosphere and respected veterans.
